sessionStart.bash: if [ -n "${COPILOT_PROJECT_DIR:-}" ]; then cd -- "$COPILOT_PROJECT_DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; fi; command -v upskill >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; n=$(upskill update --notice --repeat 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -n "$n" ] || exit 0; t=$(printf '%s\n' "$n" | tr '\001-\011\013-\037' ' ' | sed -e 's/\\/\\\\/g' -e 's/"/\\"/g' | awk 'NR>1{printf "\\n"} {printf "%s",$0}'); printf '{"additionalContext":"Tell the user at the start of your first reply: %s"}\n' "$t"
